## Checklist

- [ ] An issue was opened and agreed first (not needed for small fixes)

- [ ] `npm run test:all`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and
      `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] Tried in real Chrome on youtube.com
